title: The Spectral Eclipse Frontier: Complete Lean 4 Resolution of Conjecture 4.1, Sharp Even/Odd Rupture Thresholds, Universal 3R+2 Phase Transitions, Complex Staggered-Field Exclusion, and Quantum Speed Limits
